# Bklit UI

MIT chart source from https://bklit.com/r/{name}.json, retrieved 2026-09-09.

Registries: area-chart, background, bar-chart, chart-animation, chart-context, chart-series, chart-tooltip, chart-utils, grid, heatmap-chart, legend, ring-chart, shimmering-text, utils, x-axis, y-axis.

Local adaptation: utility imports use relative paths. Styles are compiled in usage.css with Tailwind scanning this source; preflight is excluded.

`chart-formatters.ts` follows the document language and UTC to match the usage API.
